html:
SMTO-MEM-0045 — Choose either a file or a note to add

GUID: e8ce85a9-0f0f-5386-bcc4-8f7794b6b59c
Slug: knowledge-choose-one-import-source
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • The Agent tried to add something to this conversation's Knowledge, but it gave both an attached file and a typed note, or neither. Nothing was added.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Tell the Agent clearly which to add, for example “Add the attached file to Knowledge” or “Save this text as a Knowledge note”. The Agent must pick exactly one source for each import.
  2. Or add it yourself: open Knowledge, choose the conversation, then select Upload documents for a file or Add note for text. The Knowledge page always sends exactly one file or note.
  3. Check the conversation's documents in Knowledge before adding again. This avoids adding the same file or note twice.

What success looks like

  • The file or note appears in the conversation's Knowledge documents.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO if the Agent keeps making this mistake. Nothing was added, so there is nothing to clean up.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Knowledge import tool (rag.import) was called with both a saved context_id and note text, or with neither; it requires exactly one, and nothing was imported.

What this means

  • The import request supplied both a saved context reference and note text, or supplied neither. The import requires one source and has not started.

Why this can happen

  • The import request supplied both a saved context reference and note text, or supplied neither.

How to diagnose it

  • The chosen source appears in the conversation’s Knowledge documents.

How to fix it

  • Call rag.import with exactly one of context_id (a saved attachment in this conversation) or note (text, with optional name). The rejected call raised before any import, so issuing one corrected call is safe.
  • Choose either one saved context source or one note, then submit the import again.

Retry and execution caution

  • Choose either one saved context source or one note, then submit the import again.

How to verify the fix

  • The chosen source appears in the conversation’s Knowledge documents.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
